---
name: Bug
about: Something behaved differently from how it is documented
labels: bug
---

### What you ran

Command line, target, and `squawk --version`.

### What you expected, and what happened

Paste the output. A traceback in full beats a description of one.

### Where it is documented differently

The file and the line, if the documentation and the behaviour disagree. That is
a defect on the same footing as a crash.

### Environment

Operating system and `python3 --version`. Squawk is POSIX only.

### Anything the run left behind

Run id and evidence path. Read it before attaching it.
